codeReview.summary: The fix commit directly addresses the two sampling-policy blockers from the prior failed review: order-bias validation now enforces declared schedule semantics and seed/entry integrity, and measured CLI now exits non-zero when sampling validation fails. Added tests cover schedule-type mismatch, null seed, empty entries, overall gate propagation, and compliant sampling pass behavior.
